name: University Speedrun Simulator
detailed_description:
You will play as a university student, experiencing your college life in a turn-based format.

In addition to attending core courses, you are free to spend your time however you wish—enhancing your abilities or earning money. Through a series of events, you will progress through your university days until you reach your final ending.

Of course, graduating dutifully is not your only possible outcome.


Game Features

  • Rich Events and Choices
    Every action you take advances the story through dynamic events. The decisions you make during these events will directly determine their outcomes.

  • Character Growth
    This is your golden period of personal development! Explore freely—many activities will enhance your abilities, empowering you to handle future events with greater ease.

  • Multiple Endings
    We all know that studying isn’t the only path in life. If the right opportunity arises, you can drop out, start your own business, and carve your own way—speedrunning university on your terms!
